reasons: The student's per-semester MC limit is 4, but the required courses CS3211 (4 MC), CS2102 (4 MC), and ST2334 (4 MC) cannot all be scheduled within the remaining semesters (7 and 8) without exceeding the limit in at least one semester.

CS2102 is fixed in Semester 8. CS3211 and ST2334 must be taken in Semesters 7 and 8. Placing both in Semester 7 exceeds the 4 MC limit. Placing one in Semester 7 and one in Semester 8 results in 8 MC in Semester 8 (CS2102 + one other), which also exceeds the 4 MC limit.
No other courses can be added to fill semesters, and no courses can be dropped as they are mandatory.
